method: Static review only; sample and embedded script were never executed.
format: PE32 .NET GUI executable, PS2EXE wrapper, one plaintext managed PowerShell resource
signing: Cryptographically valid self-signed Sleipnir Local Publisher certificate; no trusted publisher inference.

wrapper_review.behavior: Standard local PowerShell runspace, console/GUI bridging, arguments, help, debug, optional script extraction. No additional payload or network channel found.

script_review: Interactive WPF UI with explicit Apply/Revert controls, compatibility checks, exact-state backups and local history.
Gaming and Maximum profiles add Defender game-directory and game-process exclusions. This warrants one suspicious capability finding.
Optional settings change HVCI, VBS, CPU speculation mitigations, boot timers, power, services, startup approval, network and game configuration.
Cleanup removes enumerated caches and temporarily pauses/restarts update services; no destructive user-data or credential collection chain found.
Driver URLs are vendor HTTPS destinations; installer execution requires valid Authenticode plus the expected vendor and a recovery point.
Self-elevation uses RunAs. Remote-script elevation is guarded by an unconfigured placeholder; the executable already requests administrator privileges.
Embedded FocusGuard C# handles foreground-window events and a user hotkey; no keystroke logging or credential export found.
analysis_limitations: The full PowerShell script exceeds the parser error-recovery budget; source AST facts were dropped. Review used extracted source, IL, byte/text facts and matcher controls.
PE text extraction can omit short hashtable rows. CPU mitigation value references therefore use an ASCII/wide YARA matcher.
